products.description: The original peanut butter bar receives an upgrade with a sprinkle of Fair Trade dark chocolate chips and a pinch of sea salt. Plus, protein-packed with 20 organic superfoods, this guilt-free go-to bar satisfies any salty-sweet craving.

products.description: Whole cashews and pecans combined with the smooth, rich flavors of salted caramel and dark chocolate may seem indulgent, but this snack—made with just 5 g of sugar—only tastes like dessert.

products.description: This bar features a vanilla floral sweetness that is perfectly arranged with melt-in-your-mouth honey and smoky almonds. A host of natural seeds and brown rice crisps bound by molasses complete this crunchy delight.

products.name: KIND - Almond Coconut Cashew Chai
products.description: A sweet & nutty blend of toasted coconut, almonds and cashews is combined with exotically spiced chai for a rich and delicious snack you’ll savor from beginning to end.

products.name: That's It® – Apple + Mango Bar

products.name: Khloud™ White Cheddar Protein Popcorn

products.name: Marshmallow Dream Bar

products.name: Vanilla Biscotti with Almonds
products.description: These crispy, delicious vanilla cookies topped with crunchy almonds are love at first bite. Perfect for dipping into your favorite coffee or espresso beverage.

products.name: SkinnyDipped Coconut Almond Bite
products.description: The perfect itty-bitty indulgence to brighten your day. Loads of coconut and crunchy almonds thinly dipped into a rich, dark chocolate shell. With only 3g of sugar—you’ll taste the joy in every bite.

products.name: SkinnyDipped Dark Chocolate Cocoa Almonds
products.description: Whole roasted almonds dipped in a thin layer of dark chocolate with a hint of maple sugar and sea salt.

products.name: SkinnyDipped Lemon Bliss Almonds
products.description: Whole roasted almonds dipped in a thin layer of sweetened yogurt and infused with lemon inside and out.

products.name: Organic Valley Stringles® Mozzarella String Cheese
products.description: These Organic Valley Stringles®—low-moisture part-skim mozzarella string cheese sticks that are lightly flavored with a creamy texture—make a great snack for on the go or for added protein to your lunch.

products.name: Peter Rabbit™ Organics Strawberry Banana
products.description: These convenient, squeezable, resealable pouches contain USDA organic banana-strawberry puree with a hint of lemon juice. Perfect for busy moms on the go.

products.name: Starbucks® Sunsera Blend
products.description: Starbucks® Sunsera Blend™ is crafted for lovers of balanced, smooth, flavorful, easy-drinking coffee—hot or iced, black or with creamer. Just as the name greets the sun, the coffee itself, a blend of semi-washed and sun-dried Brazilian and washed Colombian beans, is shaped by it.

products.name: Starbucks® Green Apron Blend™
products.description:
Notes of Honeybell Orange & Graham Cracker 

This blend is for the Starbucks “partners” who wear the iconic green apron. Made up of exceptional coffees from Latin America and Africa, this coffee is soulful and essential, bright and inspiring—just like the store baristas whose pride and passion it celebrates. Starbucks will designate funds from the sale of this coffee to our Caring Unites Partners (CUP) Fund, a Starbucks program providing grants to eligible Starbucks employees in times of need.

products.name: Veranda Blend®
products.description: In Latin America, coffee farms are often run by families, with their own homes on the same land where their coffee grows. We’ve sipped coffee with these farmers for decades, sitting on their verandas, overlooking the lush beauty of the coffee trees rolling out in the distance. Most times it was a lightly roasted coffee like this one. It took us more than 80 tries to get it right—mellow and flavorful with a nice softness.

products.name: Starbucks® Blonde Espresso Roast
products.description: Experience the lighter side of espresso—a soft, beautifully balanced flavor profile that pairs perfectly with milk (or your favorite nondairy alternative). Made up of select Latin American and East African beans, this blend is carefully roasted to coax out sweet, vibrant notes of candied apple and bittersweet chocolate. The result is smooth, well-rounded and versatile, delicious served hot or over ice.

products.name: Starbucks Siren’s Blend™
products.description: The bright flavors of this medium roast are inspired—and created—by trailblazing women of the coffee industry. The juicy, citrusy and chocolaty blend combines coffee from East Africa and Latin America. Named for the Siren that symbolizes Starbucks, this blend honors the innovations of women, from farmer to roaster to barista.

products.name: Guatemala Antigua
products.description: In Antigua Valley, coffee is a family tradition and a point of pride. Generations of farmers have worked the rich volcanic soil, perfecting their craft and producing some of the finest coffees we’ve ever tasted. A favorite of ours since 1971, this coffee is rich and refined, with elegant notes of dusted cocoa and soft spice.

products.name: Pike Place® Roast
products.description: From our first store in Seattle’s Pike Place Market to our coffeehouses around the world, customers requested a freshly brewed coffee they could enjoy throughout the day. In 2008 our master blenders and roasters created this for you—a smooth, well-rounded blend of Latin American coffees with subtly rich flavors of chocolate and toasted nuts. It’s served fresh every day at a Starbucks store near you.

products.name: Decaf Pike Place® Roast
products.description: Named for our first store in Seattle’s Pike Place Market, this coffee is a smooth, well-rounded blend of Latin American beans with subtly rich notes of cocoa and praline. It’s it’s the perfect brewed coffee—a consistently delicious cup you can really look forward to. Enjoy the spirit of Pike Place in every sip.

products.name: Organic Yukon Blend®
products.description: Lively acidity and deep, earthy notes meld together in this classic blend. When you taste it, you get the balance and brightness of Latin American coffees along with the heft and the lingering herbal spiciness from Sumatran beans. Hearty, rugged and untamed—simply a great coffee.

products.name: Starbucks 1971 Roast™
products.description:
Notes of Toasted Sugar & Rich Walnut

A celebration of our heritage in sourcing and roasting the highest-quality beans since 1971. Just like the very first days of scooping beans in the Pike Place store, this blend combines some of the finest coffees in the world from Colombia, Sumatra and Brazil.

products.name: Caffè Verona®
products.description: This is a coffee of one true love, and three names. We created it just for a Seattle restaurant in 1975, naming it Jake’s Blend. And people loved it. So many, in fact, that we began hand scooping and blending it to order in our stores, where it was known as 80/20 Blend, for the recipe. The love was so strong we finally made it official, calling it Verona after the city that inspires so many. By any name, this is a thing of pure romance.

products.name: Espresso Roast
products.description:
Notes of Rich Molasses & Caramel
First created in 1975, this multi-region blend still serves as the foundation of our handcrafted espresso drinks in Starbucks stores around the world. The perfect melding of beans and roast reveals notes of rich molasses and a bold, caramelly sweetness—a flavour profile so incredible it’s never been changed. Delicious on its own or balanced with milk.

products.name: Italian Roast
products.description: This is Starbucks quintessential dark roast—expertly crafted to bring out sweetness and intensity. It showcases the precision and skill of our roasters, who created a coffee slightly darker than our Espresso Roast without the smoky edge of French Roast. A great cup of coffee with enriched flavor.

products.name: Komodo Dragon Blend®
products.description: Deep, untamed flavors ripple in this cup—earthy, herbal and complex with a lingering spice. This is the essence of coffees from Indonesia. Our master coffee blenders have brought together the best flavors of the region perfectly, creating an experience that would otherwise never exist. And is as extraordinary and wild as its namesake.

products.name: Sumatra
products.description: Grown on a lush Indonesian island, this spicy coffee is truly one of a kind. We fell in love with Sumatran coffee in 1971, and it’s been one of our most treasured offerings ever since. The taste is distinctive and unmistakable—strikingly bold and full-bodied with rich herbals, rustic spice notes and a muted acidity.

products.name: Decaf Sumatra
products.description: Grown on a lush Indonesian island, this spicy coffee is truly one of a kind. We fell in love with Sumatran coffee in 1971, and it’s been one of our most treasured offerings ever since. The taste is distinctive and unmistakable—strikingly bold and full-bodied with rich herbals, rustic spice notes and a muted acidity.

products.description: The refreshing coffee that's an instant summer sensation. Just add ice.

products.description: A mellow blend with a soft and friendly disposition, and notes of toasted malt and milk chocolate.

products.name: Starbucks VIA® Instant Pike Place® Roast
products.description: Inspired by the very first store we opened in Seattle’s Pike Place Market, Starbucks® Pike Place® Roast is a smooth, medium-roasted coffee with subtle notes of chocolate and toasted nuts.

products.name: Starbucks VIA® Instant Italian Roast
products.description: Sweet and intense with notes of dark cocoa and toasted marshmallow.

products.description: Sweet and intense with notes of dark cocoa and toasted marshmallow.
